reasons: F01, F02: material weakness from limited staffing / lack of segregation of duties, typical of a very small company with weak controls over financial reporting
F03: no auditor ICFR attestation, so the weak controls are not independently tested
F04, F21, R16: going-concern doubt alongside capital raising and securities issuance gives an incentive to present stronger results
F11: material related-party transactions raise the risk of non-arm's-length or fictitious revenue
F12, F13: one customer is 48% of revenue and 100% of receivables, an extreme concentration that is open to manipulation if that party is related
R04, R14, R15: sales grew about 12x, cash sales rose sharply and ROA changed by a very large amount, a dramatic jump from a tiny base that deserves scrutiny
R02: the gross margin index of 1.62 shows margins worsening, which partly offsets the growth story
R13: soft assets make up 100% of assets, with almost no hard assets supporting the reported activity
R08, R10, R19, R17: accruals are negative or low, operating cash flow roughly matches net income (0.96) and the F-score is 0, so there is no direct accrual-based sign of earnings inflation
F05, F06, F07, F14, F16, F17: there was no auditor change, disagreement, restatement, executive turnover or investigation, which tempers the score
